generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A permissive classifier may accept unknown members using finite exclusions, while downstream consumers may support fewer representations than the classifier accepts.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Use a positive anchor plus a denylist as proof for arbitrary unknown values, or accept a free-text representation without teaching the final resolver to consume it.
trigger_signals: same material value available in structured and free-text forms
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Require independent positive evidence or fail closed for unknown members, and require consumer parity for every accepted representation.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Attack unseen members absent from every denylist and place required values exclusively in each accepted representation, including conflicting representations.
